# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 2 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Breakpoint — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #f7f7f7 | #111111 | Page ground. Set it on `body`. True neutral — no hue. Ships in `bundle.css` as `light-dark(#f7f7f7, #111111)`. |
| `surface-raised` | #ffffff | #1c1c1c | Anything sitting on the page: cards, inputs, menus, sheets. The only other ground. `ink` and `ink-muted` both read on it. |
| `surface-sunken` | #ececec | #050505 | A well: something recessed into the page rather than sitting on it — code blocks, empty states, table header rows, scroll and progress tracks, read-only panels, and the neutral badge. It is also the hover ground for anything selectable, one step deeper as `--surface-sunken-hover`. In light it is a step darker than `surface` and still lighter than `border` (#f7f7f7 → #ececec → #d4d4d4). In dark it goes the other way, a step darker than `surface`, because `surface-raised` is what gets lighter there; `border` is lighter than both in that theme, which is inherent to dark mode. Its own fill is the edge — do not also outline it, `border` reads about 1.3:1 against it. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `accent` all read on it — `accent` is 5.0:1 there in light, 8.5:1 in dark. |
| `backdrop` | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) | The scrim behind a modal or a sheet — the only translucent token in the system. Heavier in dark on purpose, and not for the reason you would guess: a black scrim barely moves a #111111 ground at any alpha (0.5 and 0.8 differ by 0.03:1). What it actually does is collapse the contrast of the CONTENT behind it — in light the ground drops to #7c7c7c under dark text, in dark the text drops to #494949 over an unmoved ground. Same result, opposite mechanism, which is why the two alphas differ. Nothing else in the system is translucent; do not reach for it as a tint. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #171717 | #f5f5f5 | Body copy and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `accent-soft`. 14:1 or better in both themes. |
| `ink-muted` | #676767 | #8f8f8f | Secondary text, field labels, hints, placeholder. On `surface` and `surface-raised` only (5.2:1+). Do not put it on `accent-soft` — 3.8:1 in dark, under the floor. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--accent-soft);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent-soft` | #f2e5e7 | #372a2d | The selected ground: badges, chosen filter chips, selected rows and options. It is reserved for selection — a hover uses `surface-sunken` with `ink`, never this. Text on it is `accent` — 4.8:1 in light, 5.7:1 in dark. `ink` also reads on it (14.6:1) where the content is body copy rather than a label. Never `ink-muted`. Derived in `bundle.css` as `color-mix(in oklab, accent 14%, surface-raised)` in light and `22%, surface` in dark — these hex values are that mix resolved. If the accent is ever changed again, re-check `accent` on this tint: it is the tightest pair in the palette. |
| `on-accent` | #ffffff | #141414 | Text and icons on an `accent` fill. It flips: white in light (5.9:1), near-black in dark (7.7:1), because the dark rose is light. Never hard-code white on accent. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--border);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border` | #d4d4d4 | #3a3a3a | Every hairline and every control outline, 1px: card and panel edges, dividers, table rules, inputs, checkbox, radio, the switch track and its off thumb, `btn--secondary`, the overlay edge. Deliberately light — about 1.4:1 on the grounds in light and 1.6:1 in dark. That is below the 3:1 WCAG floor for a control outline, so on a bare input the line alone does not identify it: always give a field a visible `label`, and rely on the `accent` focus ring, which is solid and holds 3:1. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--accent);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent` | #9b4a60 | #dd92a3 | The one hue: a dusky rose, deep and slightly mauve in light, lifted and dustier in dark. Primary button fill, link text, focus ring, selected state, and text on `accent-soft`. As text it reads 5.5:1 on `surface`, 5.9:1 on `surface-raised`, 5.0:1 on `surface-sunken` and 4.8:1 on `accent-soft` in light; 5.7:1 or better everywhere in dark. It is a muted rose, not a signal red: that is `danger`, a separate token reserved for destructive actions, separated from this one by chroma (0.19 against 0.11 in light) rather than by hue. |
| `danger` | #ba1a1a | #f4665a | Destructive actions ONLY — the outline and text of the button that actually deletes, and nothing else. Not validation errors, not a status badge, not a warning: a field's error is still a 2px `ink` border plus the wording. It is never a fill; there is no `on-danger`, because nothing in the system sits on top of it. It is told apart from `accent` by chroma more than hue: 0.19 against the rose's 0.11 in light, 0.18 against 0.09 in dark, 23° apart in both — a vivid alarm red beside a dusky rose. As text and as a 1px outline it reads 5.5:1 or better on every ground in both themes. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Commit Mono, for code and for data that is read as a value rather than as prose. Its x-height is 0.540em against Switzer's 0.531em, so it needs no size correction: set it at the same px as the text around it.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-h1);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 32px / 36px | 600 | `sans` | Page title, one per page. Grows to 40px at `bp-desktop` and 48px at `bp-desktop-lg`. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 24px / 30px | 600 | `sans` | Section heading. Grows to 28px at `bp-desktop`. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card and subsection heading. Fixed at every width. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Intros and standfirsts. One paragraph, not a page of them. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Default for all running text and inputs. Set it on `body` and let it inherit. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Dense text: table cells, hints, button labels, secondary copy. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Field labels, badges, table headers, meta. Set in sentence case — no `text-transform`. In `ink-muted` on `surface`, `surface-raised` or `surface-sunken`; in `accent` on `accent-soft`. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Code blocks, inline code, and any value read as data: dates, times, IDs, version strings, hashes, money and figures in a table. Matches `body-sm`, so it drops into a table cell or a hint without disturbing the row. |
| `code-sm` | `.code-sm`, `--text-code-sm` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Dense meta in mono: timestamps, short IDs, build numbers beside a `label`. Matches `label`, so the two sit on one line without a baseline shift. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Switzer", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Commit Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace` |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Switzer | `fonts/Switzer-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `switzer` |
| Commit Mono | `fonts/CommitMono.woff2` (weight 200 700) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-mono)` | `commit-mono` |

Every face: `fonts/Switzer-Variable.woff2` (Switzer, 100 900), `fonts/Switzer-VariableItalic.woff2` (Switzer, 100 900, italic), `fonts/CommitMono.woff2` (Commit Mono, 200 700).

## Spacing

Nine steps, 4px base. Everything — padding, gaps, margins, icon insets — comes from here.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-text nudges, badge inset, focus offset. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap inside a control: button icon gap, checkbox to label. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Input horizontal padding, badge horizontal padding. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Default gap between related elements; page gutter on mobile. |
| `space-5` | 24px | Card padding; gap between fields in a form. |
| `space-6` | 32px | Gap between cards; page gutter from `bp-desktop`. |
| `space-7` | 48px | Gap between sections on mobile; page gutter at `bp-desktop-lg`. |
| `space-8` | 64px | Gap between sections from `bp-desktop`. |
| `space-9` | 96px | Page top and bottom padding on desktop; the largest step there is. |

## Radius

Four values. A component picks one and keeps it at every size.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 4px | Checkbox, swatch, inline code, small chips. |
| `radius-md` | 8px | Buttons, inputs, selects, menus — every interactive control. |
| `radius-lg` | 16px | Cards, panels, sheets, modals. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Badges, pills, avatars, toggle track. |

## Shadow

One shadow, for overlays only. There is no elevation scale: a thing either floats over the page or it does not.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-overlay) */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-overlay` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) | Menus, dropdowns, popovers, tooltips and autocompletes — anything that draws over content without a backdrop. Always paired with a 1px `border` on `surface-raised`; the shadow is lift, the border is the edge. Heavier in dark because a black shadow barely reads on a near-black ground. Not for cards, headers or anything that sits in the page. |

## Breakpoint

Mobile first. Base styles are the phone; these two are the only `min-width` queries in the system.

### Use

```css
/* var(--bp-desktop) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bp-desktop` | 48rem | 768px. Small desktops and landscape tablets: gutters go to `space-6`, `h1` to 40px, content caps at 60rem. |
| `bp-desktop-lg` | 75rem | 1200px. Large desktops: gutters go to `space-7`, `h1` to 48px, content caps at 72rem. |
